hooks.command: for w in wiki-school wiki-finance; do [ -f $w/hot.md ] && cat $w/hot.md; done || true

hooks.prompt: If a vault is configured for this session (check CLAUDE.md for VAULT_PATH or a wiki-school/ or wiki-finance/ folder in the current directory), silently read wiki-school/hot.md and wiki-finance/hot.md to restore recent context. If neither hot.md exists, do nothing. This is a non-vault session. Do not announce this. Do not report what you read. Just have the context available.

Hook-injected context does not survive context compaction. If wiki-school/hot.md or wiki-finance/hot.md exists in the current directory, silently re-read them now to restore the hot cache. Do not announce this.

hooks.command: [ -d .git ] && git add wiki-school/ wiki-finance/ raw/ .vault-meta/ 2>/dev/null && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "wiki: auto-commit $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" 2>/dev/null) || true

cd "$PWD" && [ -d .git ] && git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^wiki-(school|finance)/' && echo 'WIKI_CHANGED: Wiki pages were modified this session. Please update the hot.md of the wiki that changed (wiki-school/hot.md or wiki-finance/hot.md) with a brief summary of what changed (under 500 words). Use the hot cache format: Last Updated, Key Recent Facts, Recent Changes, Active Threads. Keep it factual. Overwrite the file completely. It is a cache, not a journal.' || true
